source_refs.note: Topic 3.5 Algorithm Efficiency and Scalability (PDF 81, printed 78). Short question 8 is answered.

blocks.text: An algorithm is judged by its efficiency (use of time and memory), its scalability (whether it stays efficient as input grows) and its suitability for the specific problem.

blocks.prompt: Identify the key factors used to evaluate the performance of an algorithm (short question 8).
blocks.explanation: Time complexity (how running time grows), space complexity (how memory grows), scalability with larger inputs, and suitability for the problem's needs and data; correctness is assumed first.

items: Evaluate algorithms by efficiency, scalability and suitability.
